prompt: In a bustling shipyard dock rendered in vibrant anime style, the scene is alive with activity. On the far left, a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat sits on the edge of a metal platform, looking down at the work below. Next to him stands a large rusted anchor, its chain coiled neatly beside a stack of wooden crates. In the center foreground, a woman in blue overalls points toward a massive steel hull rising from the water. Beside her, a man in a red scarf holds a rolled-up blueprint, handing it to a young apprentice in green coveralls who reaches out eagerly. A brown dog with floppy ears sits on a toolbox nearby, watching the exchange with keen interest. To the right, a foreman in a white shirt gestures sharply at a pile of welding rods scattered on the ground. A stray cat with black and white fur crouches next to the rods, eyes fixed on a seagull perched on a railing above. The seagull looks back at the cat, wings slightly spread. Behind them, two workers in orange vests carry a heavy beam together, their faces strained with effort. A small forklift driven by a person in a grey cap moves slowly past them, lifting a pallet of supplies. On the far right edge, an old fisherman in a raincoat leans against a bollard, observing the chaos. A bicycle with a basket rests against the bollard next to him. There is no sunset in the sky, keeping the lighting bright and midday. There is no water visible in the immediate foreground, focusing attention on the dock itself. The woman in blue overalls maintains a confident stance. The man in the red scarf keeps his grip firm on the paper. The apprentice balances carefully while receiving the document. The crane operator remains seated calmly. The brown dog stays still on the toolbox. The foreman continues pointing with authority. The cat remains crouched and alert. The seagull holds its perch steadily. The two workers in orange vests coordinate their steps. The forklift driver focuses on the path ahead. The old fisherman leans casually. The bicycle remains stationary. The rusted anchor lies heavy and unmoving. The wooden crates are stacked haphazardly but securely.
